A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Close-up of a bench inside an enclosure. Upper left: a white sign reading "...thesis Workstation" and black framing. Right of centre: a translucent white plastic squeeze/wash bottle standing upright on a metal base plate, fitted with a red angled spout cap, and a blue band of tape around its middle; contents appear whitish/translucent with no distinct liquid level visible. Left foreground: a similar white plastic bottle lying on its side, its orange-red spout cap pointing left and down, appearing empty. Behind them: a grey extruded aluminium profile post, a small orange-capped test tube or vial in a black holder, and metal/yellow instrument hardware with a spring at right. Grey wall background.
observations: The photograph shows plastic bottles and other hardware, but no silicone containers are observed on the workbench.
